title: Twelve, iii
logline: Thursday. Gully's, nights: the dog by the register where Maria said. Wood at the motel desk twelve blocks off. Three wide panels, two places, one hum line.

panels.composition: Gully's at night, closed, the register light on. BARNABY asleep in a bed by the register. GULLY's flatbed keys on the hook.

image.prompt: brush-pen line with muddy early-digital flat color, a wide panel of a closed bait shop at night lit only by a register light with an old dog asleep in a bed beside it, no words

panels.composition: The motel desk, 3 AM. WOOD. The hum line under the panel.

image.prompt: brush-pen line with muddy early-digital flat color, a wide panel of a motel night desk at 3 AM with a thin man in a maroon polo, a flat line beneath the panel, no words

panels.composition: Both, split by a gutter: the dog turning over in the bed; the man turning a page at the desk. The hum line under the desk half only.

image.prompt: brush-pen line with muddy early-digital flat color, a wide panel split down the middle showing an old dog turning over in a bed beside a register on the left and a man turning a page at a motel desk on the right, a flat line beneath the right half only, no words

art.line: brush-pen; the flats cleaner; the Sundays the point now

notes: Two places, one hum line. The dog by the register.
